hook: Your Mercury noon would hit about 430 degrees.
title: Mercury hits 430°C and still has ice
description:
Daytime on Mercury reaches about 430 degrees Celsius, yet the planet has water ice. It sits in permanently shadowed craters near the poles, where sunlight never reaches. Radar images from Earth showed bright patches there, and a NASA probe later backed it up.

#Shorts #Space #Mercury
comment_prompt: Would you visit Mercury? Yes or no
